name: Autumn Haze Baby Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll 5-pack | 2.5g
description: Autumn Haze packs a sweet and fruity apple flavor accented by sugary honey and a touch of nuttiness. Upon lighting this yummy Sativa, you'll feel like you're indulging in a fresh, warm mug of apple cider while taking a walk in the woods. The Autumn Haze high is equally delightful, offering a soothing body high paired with a focused and creative mind.
